name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard
description:
GameFrameX OperationClipboard — cross-platform clipboard access package with a channel registry. The core package provides IOperationClipboardManager (callback contract), OperationClipboardRegistry (mutual-exclusion resolution), a default implementation (systemCopyBuffer / Android JNI / iOS P-Invoke) and the static OperationClipboard facade. Mini-game adapters (WeChat / Alipay / Kuaishou / Douyin) ship as separate channel packages that self-register at startup. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationClipboard —— 渠道注册表式跨平台粘贴板访问功能包。主包提供 IOperationClipboardManager（回调契约）、OperationClipboardRegistry（互斥解析注册表）、默认实现（systemCopyBuffer / Android JNI / iOS P-Invoke）与 OperationClipboard 静态门面；微信 / 支付宝 / 快手 / 抖音小游戏适配拆分为独立渠道包，安装即自注册。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
